notes: Answer on instinct. Endless streaks and drills in Exercises now have an answer clock: a bar drains while you think, and running out counts as a miss. Pick Off, 8, 5 or 3 seconds on any path step (5 s to start). In an Endless streak the clock gets 0.1 s shorter with every right answer, and records are kept per clock. Also in 0.76: ∞ scale lessons on the Keys page and Endless streaks in Exercises.
